Your Habit tracker page now has a "Weekly goals" card, under Page in the note. I haven't opened the page myself, so it hasn't been checked on screen.

- **Goals:** Walk is set to 5 days, Read to 4 and Stretch to 3.
- **Progress:** each habit shows days done this week out of its goal, with a progress bar and "N days to go" or "Goal reached". The week runs Monday to Sunday, and today (Monday 5 Oct) is the first day of it, so the bars start nearly empty.
- **Changing goals:** use the − and + buttons next to each habit. The range is 1–7 days, and the goals are kept in the page's own data.
- **Renamed stat:** the old "This week" stat counted the last 7 days, so I relabelled it "Last 7 days" to avoid confusion with the new Monday–Sunday week.
